name: Osync
description: Osync is a self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted vault sync server for Obsidian. Notes are encrypted on-device (AES-256-GCM) before upload, so the server only stores encrypted blobs. This template runs the API with PostgreSQL and S3 storage (Silo, a MinIO fork) on a second domain for presigned blob transfers. After deploy, sign in at /admin/ with the generated admin credentials, create an invite code, then sign up at /signup/ and point the Obsidian plugin at your domain. The Obsidian mobile apps need HTTPS: enable it on both domains and switch the four URL variables (PUBLIC_URL, CORS_ORIGIN, S3_PUBLIC_ENDPOINT, MINIO_PUBLIC_URL) to https://.
seoDescription: Self-hosted, end-to-end encrypted Obsidian sync. Deploy Osync with Docker Compose on Dokploy – PostgreSQL, S3 storage via Silo and presigned blob transfers.
